page.compare.site_builders.title: Zintriq vs masu gina shafi
page.compare.site_builders.lead: Shafi sakamako ɗaya ne mai yiwuwa (Data + Interface + Publish)—ba samfurin ba.

page.compare.site_builders.p2.us: Tsarin iri ɗaya zai iya haɗa booking, QR, hanyoyin aiki, da sakamakon na'ura/AI na gaba.

page.compare.low_code.p1.us: Tushen abubuwa suna tsayawa; haɗuwa suna faɗaɗa.
page.compare.low_code.p2.them: Manhajar gidan yanar gizo, manhajar CRM, manhajar IoT…
page.compare.low_code.p2.us: Babu hubs na vertical na dindindin a cibiyar tunani.
